enderskills.altar.title: Altar
enderskills.altar.reset.done: Skills reset. %s XP was stored in the altar.
enderskills.altar.reset.limit: You can't reset your skills any more.
enderskills.altar.not_yet: Its effect arrives in a next version of the port.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_starter: Needs the first skill of a tree of this class.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_previous: Needs the previous skill of this tree.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_power: The altar needs more power: place Crystal Blocks around it.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_ultimate: Needs an Ultimate Altar (drop an Ender Matrix on an altar).
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_both: After the ultimate, needs both skills of the previous pair.
enderskills.altar.blocked.either_or: You chose the other skill of this pair (both are allowed after the ultimate).
enderskills.altar.blocked.levels: Your Ender Level is too low: use Ender Tokens.
enderskills.command.reset: Skills reset (spent XP stored in the altar).
skill.enderskills.charm.desc: Confuses a single enemy attracting it towards your position.
skill.enderskills.power_boost.desc: Boosts the ability strength of an ally.
skill.enderskills.nearby_invincibility.d: Grants invulnerability to all attacks except knockback to everyone in range including the user.
skill.enderskills.taunt.desc: Confuses enemies in an area attracting everyone towards your position.
skill.enderskills.wall.desc: Raises a wall of the ground's own blocks in front of you, with side walls. From level 40, use again to take it down.
skill.enderskills.dome.desc: Raises walls of the ground's own blocks all around you. From level 40, use again to take it down.
skill.enderskills.thorny.desc: Deals damage back to the attacker from melee attacks.
skill.enderskills.shockwave.desc: Stuns and pushes everyone away in the affected area.
skill.enderskills.animated_stone_golem.d: Summons a golem to fight for you. [Applies Stun debuff]
skill.enderskills.shocking_aura.desc: While active, slows enemies in an area. Use again to switch it off; drains endurance every second.
skill.enderskills.electric_pulse.desc: Electrifies and slows enemies. [Applies Electric debuff]
skill.enderskills.magnetic_pull.desc: Pulls towards you and slows enemies.
skill.enderskills.power_drain.desc: Steal the endurance from all enemies around you.
skill.enderskills.energize.desc: Refills target ally's endurance with your own.
skill.enderskills.voltaic_sentinel.desc: Summons a sentinel to assist you and your teamates. [Applies Electric debuff]
skill.enderskills.flares.desc: Pulses homing flares that deal damage. Only fires 1 at a time. Switch on/off; drains endurance every second.
skill.enderskills.blazing_aura.desc: A toggle ability that will ignite nearby enemies within. Will re-apply ignite as soon as it wears off. Drains endurance every second.
skill.enderskills.ring_of_fire.desc: Places a one way ring of fire that locks who ever steps inside. Ignites as the entity enters the ring.
skill.enderskills.home_star.desc: Grants you and allies immunity to fire/lava. Also causes you and your allies to pulse heatwaves out in an AoE. This heatwave causes damage and applies ignite.
skill.enderskills.dash.desc: Dash in any horizontal direction: hold W/A/S/D and double tap the Dash key (Left Alt).
skill.enderskills.extra_jump.desc: Allows the user to jump on air.
skill.enderskills.fog.desc: Confuses the target by limiting viewing distance, removes aggro and targetting from mobs.
skill.enderskills.smash.desc: Crush the ground, stunning enemies and dealing the fall damage to them: hold sneak in the air.
skill.enderskills.hasten.desc: Reduces the cooldown of all abilities.
skill.enderskills.warp.desc: Teleport a short way in any direction: hold W/A/S/D and double tap the Dash key (Left Alt).
skill.enderskills.invisibility.desc: Grants the user an invisible layer, deactivates when hit.
skill.enderskills.hover.desc: Fall slowly for a while with no fall damage: press jump in the air and keep holding it.
skill.enderskills.unstable_portal.desc: Summons a portal that teleports randomly any living creature upon contact.
skill.enderskills.portal.desc: Portal gun: first use places the entrance, second the exit. They stay until you use it again. Range grows with the level.
skill.enderskills.teleport.desc: Allows the user to teleport towards the crosshair.
skill.enderskills.shadow.desc: Summons a shadow copy that mimics every attack once. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.gloom.desc: Sends a quick long range beam of darkness at the enemy. It’ll hit them and quickly damage them over time.
skill.enderskills.shadow_jab.desc: Sends a quick stream of punches at the enemy. It’ll hit them and quickly damage them over time.
skill.enderskills.gas_cloud.desc: Summons a cloud of poisonous gas that explodes upon placement and slowly damages everyone over time.
skill.enderskills.grasp.desc: Summon a creature from the void to hold anyone in place in the selected area.
skill.enderskills.black_hole.desc: Summons a black hole that pulls enemies and slowly damages anyone near it over time.
skill.enderskills.bleed.desc: Gives all of your attacks the passive ability to bleed enemies. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.blood_pool.desc: Toss blood onto the floor. This blood will slowly damage the entity who stands on it.
skill.enderskills.contaminate.desc: Spits up blood onto the enemy. It’ll slowly damage them over time.
skill.enderskills.life_steal.desc: Recovers your own health for melee attacks. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.syphon.desc: Recovers your own health draining the target's.
skill.enderskills.sacrifice.desc: Consumes health but increases damage output.
skill.enderskills.slash.desc: The wind moves so fast that it causes a rip of damage at a distance. Using this ability sends out a swipe of air which goes through multiple enemies at once in a wide range.
skill.enderskills.push.desc: Pushes enemies away and stuns them.
skill.enderskills.pull.desc: Pulls enemies away and stuns them for 3 seconds.
skill.enderskills.crush.desc: Summons a wall of air that stuns the target and deals decent damage.
skill.enderskills.updraft.desc: Fling everyone up in the affected area.
skill.enderskills.suffocate.desc: Completely drain air from an area creating a void that damages over time and stops movement.
skill.enderskills.fire_spirit.desc: Gives all of your attacks the passive ability to burn enemies. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.flaming_breath.desc: Summon a flame that burns on contact.
skill.enderskills.flaming_rain.desc: Summon a cloud to make fire rain down the enemy.
skill.enderskills.focus_flame.desc: Summon a whirling column of fire that incinerates everything on it.
skill.enderskills.fireball.desc: Summon a ball of fire that explodes and burns on contact.
skill.enderskills.explode.desc: Spontaneously combust with a powerful shockwave.
skill.enderskills.radiant_ray.desc: Sends down a ray of light at the target location from above. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.lumen_wave.desc: A wave of light that goes forward from the player. Causing small knock up with minor stun. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.gleam_flash.desc: A placeable AoE that explodes after a delay. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.solar_lance.desc: Long range bolt with a very thin hit box. Pierces entities depending on level. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.barrage_wisps.desc: Cone that sends out wisps that fire out and sit in the air for a delay, then home towards the target in front. [Applies Glowing debuff]
skill.enderskills.final_flash.desc: A charge beam that takes seconds to wind up. [Applies Glowing debuff]
skill.enderskills.black_flame_ball.desc: Throws a ball of raging black fire that explodes on hit After dealing damage it continues to sap foes' HP for a very short time. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_scouring_flame.d: Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. After dealing damage it continues to sap foes' HP for a very short time. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_blessing_flame.d: Enhances the caster with the boon of the blackflame. allowing it to set the enemies ablaze on-damage that sap foes' HP for a very short time. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_raging_flame_bal: Hurls a massive ball of raging blackfire. it will explode and set the area aflame. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_volley_flame.des: The caster will shoot quickly a barrage of blackflame projectiles. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_flare_flame.desc: Cast forth a shimmering orb that will be suspended in the air and then it will flash and detonate. setting everything aflame. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.jump_height.desc: Increases the vertical velocity of every jump.
skill.enderskills.speed.desc: Increases the horizontal velocity of every step.
skill.enderskills.stealth_damage.desc: Deals extra damage when melee attacks are out of the target's field of view.
skill.enderskills.attack_speed.desc: Increases swing speed for all weapons, diminishing effects apply when using slow weapons or under the effects of fatigue.
skill.enderskills.knockback.desc: Inceases the force of knockback attacks.
skill.enderskills.critical_chance.desc: Increases the chance of dealing a crit.
skill.enderskills.armor_penetration.desc: Increases damage dealt to armored targets.
enderskills.config.title: Ender Skills
enderskills.config.ability_damage_multip: Multiplies the damage and healing of EVERY ability, at any level. 1 = like the original mod.
enderskills.config.max_level_overdrive.d: Extra power that grows with the skill level. At the max level it is (1 + this) times stronger. 2 = 3x at the top; 0 = no extra power.
enderskills.config.overdrive_curve.desc: When the overdrive appears. 1 = grows evenly with every level. 3 = almost nothing in the first levels and huge near the top (balanced early, overwhelming at the end).
enderskills.config.tree_power.desc: Extra multiplier only for the abilities of this tree, on top of the global power. 1 = normal, 2 = double, 0.5 = half.
enderskills.config.portal_range_start.de: Maximum distance between the entrance and the exit at level 0.
enderskills.config.portal_range_max: Portal distance at the top level (blocks)
enderskills.config.portal_range_max.desc: The distance grows from the value above to this one with the level. 29,999,984 = the whole world.
enderskills.config.portal_aim_range.desc: How far away you can aim to place each portal. To put the exit very far away, walk there (or type coordinates).
How far the Teleport ability takes you at level 0.
enderskills.config.teleport_range_max: Teleport distance at the top level (blocks)
enderskills.config.teleport_range_max.de: Grows from the value above to this one with the level. Very long jumps load the chunks on the way and may lag.
enderskills.config.hud_visible.desc: Endurance bar and ability list on the screen.
enderskills.config.hud_x.desc: Distance from the left side of the screen, in pixels.
enderskills.config.hud_y.desc: Distance from the top of the screen, in pixels.
enderskills.config.hud_bar.desc: Color of the endurance bar (modern and list styles).
enderskills.config.hud_ready.desc: Color of the key letters of abilities ready to use.
enderskills.config.hud_cooldown.desc: Color of abilities that are recharging.
enderskills.config.hud_active.desc: Color of abilities that are active right now (auras, buffs, open portals).
enderskills.config.cost_multiplier.desc: Multiplies the XP price of every skill. 0.5 = the original mod; 0 = free; 2 = twice as expensive.
enderskills.config.cost_increment.desc: Each new tree you start costs more than the previous ones: price x (1 + this x skills unlocked before it). 0 = every tree costs the same.
enderskills.config.one_tree.desc: On: in each class (Defense, Mobility, Offense) you can only start one element tree. Off: you can learn every tree.
enderskills.config.max_resets.desc: How many times a player can use the altar's Reset button (it gives back part of the spent XP).
enderskills.config.retry_return.desc: Part of the spent XP stored back in the altar when you reset. 1 = all of it, 0.8 = 80%, 0 = nothing.
enderskills.config.store_tariff.desc: Part of your XP that stays in the altar when you click Store XP. 1 = nothing is lost.
enderskills.config.take_tariff.desc: Part of the stored XP you receive when you click Take XP. 0.8 = you lose 20%.
enderskills.config.default_endurance.des: Endurance (the blue bar) every player has before the Endurance attribute. Abilities spend it; it refills a few seconds after you stop using them.
enderskills.config.default_level.desc: Ender Level of new players. Your N-th ability needs Ender Level N; Ender Tokens raise it.
enderskills.config.token_drops.desc: Monsters killed by an ability can drop an Ender Token.
enderskills.config.token_rate.desc: 0.07 = 7% per monster killed by an ability; 1 = always.
enderskills.config.hurt_timer.desc: Built-in Better Hurt Timer: each kind of damage (fire, arrows, each attacker...) has its own short invulnerability, so different sources can hurt at the same time. Off = vanilla behaviour.
enderskills.config.hurt_timer_diff.desc: Inside the invulnerability time, a hit that is this much stronger (in damage points) than the last one still hurts.
enderskills.portal.too_far: Too far from the entrance (max %s blocks).
enderskills.config.portal_always_open.de: On: your portals stay open at any level until you use the Portal ability again. Off: below the top level they close by themselves after the time set below.
enderskills.config.portal_close_start.de: How long portals stay open at level 0 before closing by themselves.
enderskills.config.portal_close_end: Portal lifetime just below the top level (seconds)
enderskills.config.portal_close_end.desc: The lifetime grows from the value above to this one as you level up. At the top level portals only close when you want.
enderskills.config.coordinates.desc: Sneak and press the Portal or Teleport key to open a window where you type X Y Z (~ = your position). Portal: exit at the coordinates. Teleport: goes there.
enderskills.config.teleport_ground.desc: On: you always land on the ground below the target (no fall). Off: you can appear in the air where you aimed.
enderskills.config.status_overlay.desc: A colored, pulsing frame around your screen (like freezing) while you are stunned, electrified, rooted, bleeding, burning in black flame or gassed.
enderskills.coords.title: Target coordinates
enderskills.command.unknown: Unknown skill for this command (use the suggestions).
enderskills.command.bad_level: The level must be a number or max.
enderskills.altar.book_mode: read anywhere · unlock at an altar
enderskills.altar.book_needs_altar: Use an altar to unlock or upgrade.
enderskills.altar.hint: Choose a class and a tree on the left, then hover or click a skill to see what it does and what it costs.
enderskills.config.sound_volume.desc: Volume of all Ender Skills sounds. 1 = full volume, 0.5 = half, 0 = silent.
enderskills.config.extra_sounds.desc: Besides the original Ender Skills sound, abilities also play Minecraft sounds (explosions, zaps, wind...). Turn off to hear only the original sounds.
enderskills.config.vfx_density.desc: Amount of particles in the ability effects. 1 = normal, 2 = double (prettier), 0.3 = light (for weak computers).
enderskills.config.skill_volume.desc: Volume of this ability's original sound, multiplied by the master volume. 1 = normal, 0 = mute this ability.
enderskills.config.creative_free.desc: In creative mode every skill can be unlocked and upgraded with no XP, no Ender Level and no tree rules (also from the Ender Book).
enderskills.config.hud_style.desc: Modern: glass panel with abilities side by side. List: the look of versions 1.0 to 1.2. Original: like the 1.12.2 Ender Skills (blue boss bar and a column of abilities).
enderskills.config.hud_panel.desc: Opacity of the dark panel behind the HUD. 0 = no background, 1 = solid.
enderskills.config.hud_special.desc: Also show Dash, Warp, Smash, Hover and Extra Jump (they have no key; they are used with double tap, jump and sneak).
enderskills.config.altar_background.desc: Background behind the altar / Ender Book screen. Cosmic: animated End sky. Blur: the game world, blurred. Transparent: the game world, clear.
enderskills.hud.title: Endurance
enderskills.config.hud_group_label.desc: Shows the current ability group (for example "Mobility: Void") above the hearts, food and XP bar. The HUD and the ability keys only use the abilities of this group; change it with the Left and Right arrow keys.
enderskills.teleport.no_target: Aim at a block to teleport.
enderskills.config.teleport_no_sky.desc: On: Teleport only works when you aim at a block; aiming at the sky does nothing (no cost).
enderskills.config.effect_style.desc: Original: Minecraft's effects, as in the first versions (blindness, darkness, poison, slowness, weakness, fire resistance). Current: the mod's own effects (Stunned, Electrified, Rooted, Gassed...) without darkening the screen. Both: all of them.
enderskills.config.earth_toggle_level.de: From this Wall / Dome level on, the wall stays until you use the ability again (on/off). Below it, it crumbles after the skill's duration.
enderskills.config.wall_width.desc: 0 = the value of the skill config (5).
enderskills.config.wall_height.desc: 0 = the value of the skill config (5).
enderskills.config.wall_thickness.desc: How many blocks thick the wall is.
enderskills.config.wall_wings.desc: Side walls at both ends of the Wall, folded towards you to protect your sides. 0 = a flat wall.
enderskills.config.wall_distance.desc: How far in front of you the Wall rises. 0 = automatic.
enderskills.config.dome_radius.desc: 0 = the value of the skill config (3 to 6 by level).
enderskills.config.dome_height.desc: 0 = the value of the skill config (5).
enderskills.config.dome_roof.desc: Close the Dome with a roof. Off = only the ring of walls.
enderskills.config.earth_copy_ground.des: Walls are made of the block below them (dirt, stone, cobblestone...). Sand, gravel and blocks with an inventory use the fallback block.
enderskills.config.earth_replace_small: Move small blocks out of the way
enderskills.config.earth_replace_small.d: Slabs, carpets, grass, flowers, snow... in the way are removed and put back when the wall goes away. Off = the wall leaves a gap there.
enderskills.config.earth_fallback.desc: Block id used when the ground can't be copied, for example minecraft:stone_bricks.
enderskills.config.invis_name.desc: While you are invisible (Invisibility ability or potion) no name tag is drawn above you. Name tags drawn by other mods are not affected.
enderskills.config.invis_dust.desc: While you are invisible, sprinting kicks up no dust particles.
enderskills.config.skill_enabled.desc: Off: this skill can't be unlocked or used and gives no bonus (already unlocked ones stop working).
enderskills.config.skill_max_level.desc: Highest level that can be bought at the altar. The values below are spread from level 0 to this level.
enderskills.config.prop.desc: Original value: %s. Changing it replaces the original curve with a straight line between level 0 and the max level; put both values back to the original to use the curve again.
enderskills.config.cooldown_multiplier.d: Multiplies the cooldown of every ability. 0.5 = half the time, 0 = no cooldown.
Multiplies the endurance every ability spends. 0 = free.
enderskills.config.duration_multiplier.d: Multiplies how long abilities, auras and effects last.
enderskills.config.range_multiplier.desc: Multiplies the range and the area size of every ability.
enderskills.altar.blocked.disabled: This skill is switched off in the settings.
enderskills.config.skill_particles.desc: Amount of particles of this skill (1 = normal, 0 = none, 2 = double).
enderskills.config.skill_custom_color.de: On: the glows, 3D shapes and trails of this skill use the color below.
enderskills.config.skill_color.desc: Color used when "Custom color" is on.
enderskills.config.max_particles.desc: No single effect sends more particles than this. Lower it if abilities make the game stutter (120 = default).
enderskills.config.vfx_shapes.desc: Glowing 3D shapes: light columns, beams, black holes, cosmic clouds, fire rain, explosions.
enderskills.config.vfx_trails.desc: See-through copies behind you with Dash, Warp, Teleport and Speed Boost.
enderskills.config.vfx_vibrate.desc: Blurred, shaking copies around a player under Hasten (like the Reverse Flash).
enderskills.config.wall_scale.desc: Shrinks or grows the Wall (1 = normal, 0.5 = half the width and height). Used when width/height below are 0.
enderskills.config.wall_max_width.desc: The Wall is never wider than this, in blocks (0 = no limit).
enderskills.config.wall_max_height.desc: The Wall is never taller than this, in blocks (0 = no limit).
enderskills.config.dome_scale.desc: Shrinks or grows the Dome (1 = normal, 0.5 = half). Used when radius/height below are 0.
enderskills.config.dome_max_radius.desc: The Dome is never wider than this, in blocks (0 = no limit).
enderskills.config.dome_max_height.desc: The Dome is never taller than this, in blocks (0 = no limit).
enderskills.config.vfx_style.desc: Original: the models and shaders of the original mod (cosmic black hole and gas cloud, black fists, glow sprites, auras). Current: this port's particles and 3D shapes. Both: everything.
enderskills.config.fog_radius.desc: Size of the cloud of fog and smoke around you; enemies inside are blinded and lose track of you.
enderskills.config.fog_toggle_level.desc: From this level on, the fog stays until you use it again or until the time limit below.
enderskills.config.fog_max_seconds.desc: At that level, the fog ends by itself after this time.
enderskills.config.speed_boost_step.desc: While Speed Boost is on you walk up blocks by yourself: extra step height in blocks (1.4 = 2 blocks, 0 = off).
enderskills.config.passive_mode.desc: Button: Shadow, Bleed, Life Steal and Fire Spirit get an ability key to switch them on and off. Always on: they always work. Always on with one tree: always on only if you have a single skill tree, otherwise with a button.
enderskills.config.modify_environment.de: Abilities leave things in the world for a while: black fire of the Black Flames, blood on the ground of Blood Pool and Bleed. They go away by themselves.
enderskills.config.destroy_environment.d: Black Hole, Explode and Fireball break the blocks around them (bigger ability = bigger hole).
enderskills.config.environment_seconds.d: How long the black fire and the blood stay.
enderskills.config.player_damage_multipl: Multiplies ability damage on other players, for fair PvP (0.4 = 40%).
enderskills.config.boss_damage_multiplie: Multiplies ability damage on bosses: Wither, Ender Dragon, Warden (0.6 = 60%).
enderskills.config.sound_style.desc: Original: the Ender Skills sounds. Minecraft: the Minecraft sounds of the first port versions (quieter). Both: all of them. Each ability can also choose its own (in its group).
enderskills.config.skill_sound_style.des: Sound of this ability: the general setting, Original, Minecraft or both. The Electric tree starts with Minecraft.
enderskills.config.speed_boost_power.des: Multiplies the Speed Boost bonus: 1 = normal (level 50 is about twice as fast), 0.5 = half, 2 = double.
enderskills.config.gloom_volley_level.de: From this level Gloom fires several shots at once, each at another mob in front of you.
enderskills.config.gloom_max_shots.desc: How many shots Gloom fires at the max level (it grows from 2 at the volley level).
enderskills.config.area_duration.desc: How long the areas of the abilities stay on the ground (gas cloud, black hole, blood pool, flaming rain...): 1 = original, 1.5 = 50% longer.
enderskills.config.gas_cloud_size.desc: Size of the Gas Cloud (1 = original).
enderskills.config.gas_cloud_hold.desc: Mobs caught in the cloud are held in place and blinded for this long (0 = no).
enderskills.config.black_hole_size.desc: Size and pull area of the Black Hole (1 = original).
enderskills.config.black_hole_duration.d: Extra time of the Black Hole, on top of the area time (1 = original).
enderskills.config.blood_pool_size.desc: Size of the Blood Pool (1 = original); the blood covers the ground and follows it.
enderskills.config.second_rune_ring_leve: From this level on, two rune circles spin around you instead of one.
enderskills.config.earth_toggle_max.desc: In toggle mode the Wall / Dome stays until you use the ability again, but still goes away by itself after this many seconds, so it is never forgotten (0 = never).
enderskills.config.portal_max_pairs.desc: How many pairs of portals can be open at once (1st + 2nd use = a pair, 3rd + 4th = another...). A new pair past this closes the oldest.
enderskills.portals.title: Portals
enderskills.portals.none: No pair open. Use Portal twice to open one.
enderskills.portals.new_label: New pair: entrance in front of you, exit at the coordinates (and dimension)
enderskills.config.invis_mobs_forget.des: While Invisibility is on, mobs stop chasing you, even the ones you hit: they don't know where you are.
enderskills.config.invis_particles.desc: No particle shows around an invisible player (potion swirls, steps, hits, ability effects).
enderskills.config.shadow_minion_level.d: From this Shadow level, shadows of you walk around and fight hostile mobs near you (2 at first).
enderskills.config.shadow_minion_max.des: How many fighting shadows at the top level; one more comes every few levels until then (up to 100).
Damage of each hit of a fighting shadow, times your ability power.
enderskills.config.shadow_minion_range.d: How far from you (blocks) the shadows look for hostile mobs.
enderskills.shadows.title: Fighting shadows
enderskills.config.invis_unbreakable: Invisible: damage doesn't break it from level
enderskills.config.invis_unbreakable.des: From this Invisibility level on, taking damage no longer breaks it (0 = it never breaks).
enderskills.config.portal_reach.desc: How much of the visible round portal works as the portal: 0.85 = almost the whole ring, 1 = all of it. Before, only the middle counted.
enderskills.config.hasten_refill_level.d: From this Hasten level on, using it resets the cooldown of every other ability (0 = never).
enderskills.config.hasten_cooldown_facto: Multiplies the cooldown of Hasten itself (0.8 = 20% shorter, 1 = unchanged).
enderskills.config.hasten_phase_level.de: From this Hasten level on you walk through walls while it lasts; holding Shift you sink through blocks, Jump takes you back up. No fall or suffocation damage (0 = never).
enderskills.config.shadow_minion_drain.d: Energy per second that each fighting shadow costs. They cannot die: they are gone only when your energy runs out.
enderskills.config.shadow_minion_top_fac: At the top Shadow level the upkeep is multiplied by this (0.5 = half).
enderskills.config.black_hole_pull_range: How far the Black Hole pulls and hurts, as a multiple of its drawn size (1 = only inside it).
enderskills.config.black_hole_cooldown_a: The Black Hole's cooldown only starts when the hole is gone (instead of when you cast it).
enderskills.config.black_hole_blocks.des: With "destroy the environment" on, the Black Hole rips this many blocks per tick out of the ground and swallows them: a crater.
enderskills.config.damage_passive: Abilities hurt passive and neutral mobs
enderskills.config.damage_passive.desc: Off (like the original): abilities only hurt hostile mobs, or passive/neutral ones that are already aggressive. On: they hurt every mob that is not your ally.
enderskills.shadows.exhausted: The shadows are gone: no energy left
enderskills.config.unstable_far.desc: When you step into an Unstable Portal you are thrown far away (see the distances) instead of a few blocks.
enderskills.config.unstable_min.desc: The least distance an Unstable Portal throws you.
enderskills.config.unstable_max.desc: The most distance an Unstable Portal throws you (up to the world border).
enderskills.config.unstable_dimension.de: Now and then the throw lands you in a random other dimension.
enderskills.config.unstable_dimension_ch: How often the throw goes to another dimension (0.2 = 20%).
enderskills.config.unstable_return_dista: When you land at least this far from the Unstable Portal (or in another dimension) a portal back to it opens where you land. Using it dissipates it; the original stays.
enderskills.config.unstable_return_secon: How long the portal back stays open.
enderskills.config.unstable_reach: Unstable Portal collision (share of the ring)
enderskills.config.unstable_reach.desc: How much of the visible ring of the Unstable Portal throws you: 0.85 = almost the whole ring, 1 = all of it.
enderskills.config.infinite_endurance.de: Energy never runs out: costs are not charged. The energy value itself has no limit either (billions, trillions...).
enderskills.config.teleport_cooldown_lev: From this Teleport level its cooldown goes down towards the value below at the top level (0 = off).
enderskills.config.teleport_cooldown_top: Teleport's cooldown in seconds at its last level.
enderskills.unstable.return: A portal back opened next to you (%s s)
enderskills.unstable.no_place: Unstable Portal: no safe place found
enderskills.unstable.timeout: Unstable Portal: the destination took too long
enderskills.config.black_hole_top_bonus: Extra size at the top level (blocks)
How many blocks bigger the Black Hole is at its last level (0 to 1000). It grows with the level and takes the pull range, the blocks it rips and its damage with it.
enderskills.config.black_hole_block_radi: The farthest from its center the Black Hole rips blocks out of the ground (needs "destroy the environment").
enderskills.config.black_hole_damage_sec: Damage dealt to the mobs inside the Black Hole every second, as a share of its damage (0.4 = 40% per second).
enderskills.config.passive_speed_power.d: Multiplies the Speed passive of the altar (original: +10% at the last level; 6 = +60%).
enderskills.config.passive_swim_power.de: Multiplies the extra swimming speed of the Swim Speed passive (1 = up to twice as fast at the last level).
Multiplies the Attack Speed passive (original: +80% at level 20; 2 = +160%).
enderskills.config.crit_multiplier.desc: How much more damage a critical hit of the Critical Chance passive deals (2 = double).
enderskills.config.passive_report.desc: Once after you join, the chat lists what each passive really does (read from the game's own attributes).
enderskills.passives.title: Ender Skills: your passives right now:
enderskills.config.swim_efficiency.desc: How much of the water efficiency of the Swim Speed passive is used. 1 = you swim as fast as you run (too hard to control); lower is calmer.
enderskills.config.swim_breath.desc: At the last level (before the infinite one) you lose air this many times slower. It grows with the level.
enderskills.config.swim_vision_level: Clear sight under water from level
enderskills.config.swim_vision_level.des: From this Swim Speed level you see clearly under water (0 = never).
enderskills.config.swim_air_level.desc: From this Swim Speed level your air never runs out and the bubbles don't even show (0 = never).
enderskills.config.unstable_max_radius.d: The widest the Unstable Portal can be, in blocks (it grows with the level up to 4; the collision follows it).
enderskills.config.dash_min.desc: How far the Dash carries you at its first level.
enderskills.config.dash_max.desc: How far the Dash carries you at its last level (a fast run, to get out of danger).
enderskills.config.dash_double_tap.desc: On: two quick taps of the key (Left Alt = Dash, Right Alt = Warp). Off: one press.
enderskills.config.warp_min.desc: How far the Warp teleports you at its first level, through walls, to where you look.
enderskills.config.warp_max.desc: How far the Warp teleports you at its last level (up to 1000).
enderskills.config.fall_safe_bonus.desc: Fall Resistance also adds this many blocks of safe fall at its last level, on top of the extra jump height.
Multiplies the Damage passive (original: +100% at level 50 = a fist of 2 damage; 4 = +400%, a fist of 5).
enderskills.config.crit_chance_power.des: Multiplies the Critical Chance passive (40% at its last level; 2 = 80%). Never above 100%.
enderskills.config.black_hole_suction.de: How fast the Black Hole sucks the blocks in (1 = slow, 2 = fast, up to 10).
enderskills.config.black_hole_depth: Crater depth at the top level
enderskills.config.black_hole_depth.desc: How deep the crater goes at the last level, in blocks (it grows with the level from 3).
enderskills.config.shader_compat.desc: With a shader pack on (Iris), effects use Minecraft's own render types so they show up. Auto: only while a shader pack is on. On: always. Off: never.
